courseTitle: Ionic - Build iOS, Android & Web Apps with Ionic & Angular

cues.en: In this module, we sent a lot of HTTP requests and we worked a lot with observables. I hope this also
the power of observables and how they help us orchestrate steps and ensure that they run in the right order
and with that, we're now able to send requests related to places, to adding places, fetching places, editing
places but also of course related to our bookings.
You also learned how to show spinners and use the different lifecycle hooks correctly,
how to handle errors like in a scenario where we try to edit or view something where we have no data
on and with all that, you got a toolbox of features that should help you build the app
you're trying to get out into the stores because chances are high that this app will also require HTTP
and here, we learned a lot about that.
